# GoatDB

> GoatDB is a TypeScript local-first document database for applications where humans, agents, and services share verifiable, synchronized state.

## Getting Started

- [Installation](https://goatdb.dev/docs/install): Install GoatDB and choose the Deno or Node.js workflow.
- [Tutorial](https://goatdb.dev/docs/tutorial): Build and run a complete synchronized application.
- [CLI and Build Tools](https://goatdb.dev/docs/cli): Scaffold, develop, and compile a GoatDB application.

## Build and Styling

- [Customize Client Styling](https://goatdb.dev/docs/styling): Configure base CSS, imported CSS, esbuild CSS plugins, hashed assets, maps, and rebuild watching.
- [AppConfig API](https://goatdb.dev/api/GoatDB/type-aliases/AppConfig): Reference for client asset paths, build options, and `esbuildPlugins`.

## Core Guides

- [Architecture](https://goatdb.dev/docs/architecture): Understand the local-first runtime, repositories, and synchronization model.
- [Concepts](https://goatdb.dev/docs/concepts): Key concepts and terminology.
- [Schemas](https://goatdb.dev/docs/schema): Define and register data schemas before creating items.
- [Reading and Writing Data](https://goatdb.dev/docs/read-write-data): Create, query, update, and delete managed items.
- [React Integration](https://goatdb.dev/docs/react): Connect GoatDB state to React components and subscriptions.
- [Sessions](https://goatdb.dev/docs/sessions): Authenticate sessions and work with signed commits.
- [Authorization Rules](https://goatdb.dev/docs/authorization): Define rules enforced for every operation.
- [Synchronization](https://goatdb.dev/docs/sync): Configure and reason about replica synchronization.

## Optional

- [Conflict Resolution](https://goatdb.dev/docs/conflict-resolution): Resolve concurrent field changes with merge strategies.
- [Commit Graph](https://goatdb.dev/docs/commit-graph): Understand the append-only source of truth for repository state.
- [Repositories](https://goatdb.dev/docs/repositories): Independent units of data synchronization and access control.
- [Benchmarks](https://goatdb.dev/docs/benchmarks): Performance characteristics and comparisons.
- [FAQ](https://goatdb.dev/docs/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [API Reference](https://goatdb.dev/api): Browse the complete generated TypeScript API.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/goatplatform/goatdb): Source code, issues, and release history.

## Network Architecture

- **Carrier**: HTTP (current); WebSocket and WebRTC planned
- **Trigger**: Polling with 200ms scheduler checks plus per-repository adaptive 300–1500ms cycles
- **Typical latency**: 700–1000ms application-perceived
- **Topology**: Server-coordinated (current); direct P2P via WebRTC planned
- **Sync protocol**: Transport-independent, delta-compressed, Bloom-filter-based reconciliation
